title: Brewability / Pizzability
venue_description:
Brewability / Pizzability

Brewability and its sister kitchen Pizzability share a home on South Broadway in Englewood. The brewery and pizzeria is built around inclusion and accessibility and is known across the Denver area as a place where everyone is welcome both behind the counter and in the crowd.

The Vibe

Expect a bright and friendly taproom with pizza coming out of the kitchen and a crowd that mixes families and neighbors and craft beer fans. The room is designed to be accessible and the staff sets a tone of patience and warmth that carries straight into the open mic.

Sunday Open Mic and Audition

Every Sunday afternoon from 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM the stage opens to musicians and poets and other performers. The session doubles as an audition of sorts because the venue books weekend gigs and private events and a strong set can lead to a paid booking. Performers are thanked with a free pint or a slice of pizza. It is a daytime slot which makes it a great fit for newer players and for anyone who prefers an early show.

Food and Drink

House beers are poured alongside a pizza menu from Pizzability. It is an easy place to settle in for the whole afternoon.

Good to Know

Brewability / Pizzability is located at 3445 S Broadway Englewood CO 80113. Call (303) 344-8988 for current details. Schedules can change so confirm with the venue or host before heading out.

title: Green Mountain Beer Company
venue_description:
Green Mountain Beer Company

Green Mountain Beer Company is a neighborhood craft brewery in south Lakewood close to the foothills. It is a laid-back spot where locals gather over house beers and where Sunday evenings belong to one of the most popular open mics on the west side of metro Denver.

Sunday Open Mic

The open mic runs every Sunday from 5:00 PM to about 8:45 PM. The official sign-up is at 4:00 PM but the list fills quickly so arriving early is a smart move. A house band is often on hand and will back performers who want a fuller sound which makes this a great place to try a song with drums and bass behind you. Bill Moore steps in as host on some weeks.

Why Musicians Like It

The combination of a supportive crowd and an available house band gives solo songwriters a chance to stretch out. Regulars return week after week so newcomers quickly find friends and future jam partners.

Good to Know

Green Mountain Beer Company is located at 2585 S Lewis Way Lakewood CO 80227. Call (303) 986-0201 for current details. Schedules can change so confirm with the venue or host before heading out.

title: Western Sky
venue_description:
Western Sky

Western Sky is a neighborhood bar on South Broadway in Englewood with a relaxed and unpretentious feel. It is part of a stretch of Broadway that has become one of the busiest open mic corridors in the south metro area.

Sunday Mixed Open Mic

Sunday evenings from 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM the bar hosts a mixed open mic that welcomes musicians and poets and rappers and other acts. Sign-up happens in person at the bar starting at 5:30 PM. Musicians get two songs and other performers get about five minutes so the list moves quickly and a lot of people get a turn.

Good Fit For

Quick sets make this a nice spot to test a new song or warm up before heading to a later Sunday mic elsewhere in Denver.

Good to Know

title: MECO Coffee Collective
venue_description:
MECO Coffee Collective

title: Lucky Joe's Sidewalk Saloon
venue_description:
Lucky Joe's Sidewalk Saloon

Lucky Joe's Sidewalk Saloon sits right on Old Town Square in the heart of downtown Fort Collins. The pub is home to what is billed as the longest running open mic in the area with more than three decades of Sunday nights behind it.

Sunday Open Mic Night

Host Joe Vegas runs the Sunday open mic and the format is a little different from most. The list goes up around 11:00 AM on Sunday and players can claim a slot by phone or in person. Sets run about 20 to 30 minutes which gives each act room to play a real set. The show runs from roughly 8:00 PM to 11:00 PM. Bring your own instrument because there are no loaners.

The Setting

The Old Town location puts the saloon steps from other Fort Collins music rooms and breweries. On warm nights the square is busy and the music spills into a lively downtown scene.

venue_description:
Squire Lounge

The Young Squire Open Mic

The Young Squire Open Mic starts at 9:00 PM every Sunday with sign-up at 8:30 PM. Host Duke Justice leads the Squire House Band and the venue supplies drums and amps and a PA. That means singers can call a tune and have a band ready to go and instrumentalists can plug in without hauling a full rig.

The Vibe

The room is gritty and friendly and very Colfax. The late start draws working musicians who have finished weekend gigs along with night owls who love live music.

title: The Bug Theatre
venue_description:
The Bug Theatre

The Bug Theatre is a historic neighborhood theater in northwest Denver that has been a home for independent performance for decades. It is also home to Freak Train which is one of the longest running open stage shows in the city.

Freak Train Open Mic Variety Show

Freak Train rolls on the last Monday of the month. Performers sign up at 7:00 PM for 12 open slots and the show starts at 8:00 PM. Each performer gets five minutes to do nearly anything they want. Singers and musicians share the bill with actors and dancers and magicians and many other acts. Hosts GerRee Hinshaw and booth operator Alex Weimer have kept the show running since 2000. Admission is about five dollars and beer is part of the fun. The show often skips December.

Why It Matters

Few stages in Denver offer a real theater with lights and seating for an open night. It is a memorable place to try a song in front of a big and enthusiastic crowd.

title: Monolith Brewing
venue_description:
Monolith Brewing

Funk'd Up Tuesdays

Tuesday nights from 6:30 PM to 9:30 PM belong to a funk-centered open jam. Drums and percussion and amps and microphones and a PA are provided so players just bring their instruments. Each musician can lead two songs and sit in on others when there is room. Other styles are welcome as long as the energy stays groovy and upbeat. The jam is all ages. This listing is awaiting verification so confirm before you go.

Wednesday Night Bluegrass Jam

Every Wednesday from 7:00 PM to 9:00 PM the brewery hosts a bluegrass jam for pickers and strummers and fiddlers. Bring your instrument and join the circle.

The Vibe

A friendly brewery setting with a crowd that loves live music. Few venues in Denver offer two different styles of open jam in the same week.

Good to Know

title: The Alley
venue_description:
The Alley

Tuesday Night Open Mic

The open mic runs every Tuesday from 7:00 PM to 10:00 PM. Sign-up is in person at 6:30 PM sharp and there are 13 spots of about 15 minutes or three songs each. A lottery draw decides the order in which players pick their slots. A full PA is provided and performers can bring instruments or backing tracks. The night is for music and performance art only so stand-up comedy is not part of it. It is all ages with no cover.

The Community

Regulars often make room for newcomers and the host keeps a spot that can be shared. Laptop performers and unusual acts are welcome and the room embraces the weird and wonderful.

Good to Know
